verdict.rationale: Only community evidence speaks to the pricing model: users describe a price-per-search model and record limits, which means unit-based billing exists. There is no first-party pricing page or published per-unit rate in the pack, so a founder cannot confirm from this evidence that costs are predictable. Users also report that replica indexes multiply record counts unexpectedly. Missing for 10: first-party published per-unit price list (per search/record), documented plan tiers or calculator, and evidence that costs can be predicted before committing.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing

citations.quote: it's easy to exceed Algolia's record limits because every 'sort by' option needs a duplicate replica index
